bio.text: Suhas Subramanyam represents Virginia's 10th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives.
He served in the Virginia House of Delegates from 2019 to 2023 and the Virginia State Senate from 2023 to 2024, and earlier was a White House technology policy advisor to President Obama.
He earned a B.A. from Tulane University and a J.D. from Northwestern University's Pritzker School of Law, and lives in Loudoun County, Virginia.
